card.name: Bodily motion verbs and landing phrases
card.fires_on: Words in descriptions of physical movement, such as springing, bouncing, landing or falling, mostly a verb or a small word right after one. It responds on the word that continues the motion.

modes.label: Motion verb or particle
modes.description: A verb or particle in a bodily movement, such as spring, bounce up and down, or fall into.
modes.example: still bouncing up and<< down>> with excitement as she held her catch in

modes.label: Landing and jumping instructions
modes.description: Small words in exercise or gymnastics text about landing or dropping into a position.
modes.example: we know that we will land shortly<< in>> a place near our starting point.

modes.label: Sudden reaction verbs
modes.description: A verb for a sudden bodily action, such as sputtering or springing up.
modes.example: he sput<<tered>> water and regained consciousness.
